mapper.select: /* AttdCloseMapper.countNodeAdmin */ WITH RECURSIVE anc AS ( SELECT N.NODE_CD, N.PARENT_NODE_CD, N.MAIN_ADMIN_CD, N.SUB_ADMIN_CD FROM TB_SITE_NODE N WHERE N.CMPNY_CD = #{cmpnyCd} AND N.SITE_CD = #{siteCd} AND N.NODE_CD = #{nodeCd} UNION ALL SELECT P.NODE_CD, P.PARENT_NODE_CD, P.MAIN_ADMIN_CD, P.SUB_ADMIN_CD FROM TB_SITE_NODE P JOIN anc A2 ON P.CMPNY_CD = #{cmpnyCd} AND P.SITE_CD = #{siteCd} AND P.NODE_CD = A2.PARENT_NODE_CD ) SELECT COUNT(*) FROM anc WHERE MAIN_ADMIN_CD = #{userCd} OR SUB_ADMIN_CD = #{userCd}
